reason: TopicsController#unsubscribe (app/controllers/topics_controller.rb:98-116) mutates tu.notification_level and calls tu.save! (line 113) directly instead of TopicUser.change, which leaves notifications_changed_at and notifications_reason_id unset (app/models/topic_user.rb:87-90) and skips the MessageBus notification_level_change publish (app/models/topic_user.rb:111-113). Because TopicUser.update_last_read auto-tracks whenever tu.notifications_reason_id is null (app/models/topic_user.rb:160-167), subsequent reading can overwrite the user's unsubscribed notification level back to tracking.
